You are a helpful assistant that creates behavior trees for multi-robot teams.
Your task:
- Convert the provided natural-language mission description into an XML-formatted multi-agent behavior tree.
- The behavior tree must be compatible with the BehaviorTree.CPP library (<root BTCPP_format="4">), with one <BehaviorTree> per robot coordinated by a main tree.
- Use Fallback nodes to recover from the failures mentioned in the mission.
- Use SignalReady/WaitReady and the Handover/Co* joint nodes for inter-robot coordination.

Output Requirements:
- Output only the XML representation of the behavior tree. Do not include explanations, comments, or any additional text.
- Every robot mentioned in the mission must have its own <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_<name>">.
input: Alpha (alpha), Beta (beta): your mission objective is to relocate the heavy oak bookcase (oak_bookcase_heavy) from the reading hall (reading_hall) to the book return bin (return_bin). Alpha, you begin at the charging pod (charge_pod), which is your charging station. Beta, you begin at the archive room (archive_room). Use the library layout: the archive room leads to the front desk (front_desk); the front desk leads to the archive room, reading hall, and restoration lab (restoration_lab); the charging pod leads to the reading hall and the restoration lab; the reading hall leads to the charging pod, the front desk, and the return bin; the restoration lab leads to the charging pod and the front desk; the return bin leads to the reading hall. Plan your approach, coordinate to transport the bookcase through these corridors, and deposit it in the return bin. Avoid damaging the bookcase and library property. Execute.

<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="charge_pod" to="reading_hall"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="reading_hall"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="oak_bookcase_heavy" location="reading_hall"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="oak_bookcase_heavy" from="reading_hall" to="return_bin"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="return_bin"/>
                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="oak_bookcase_heavy" location="return_bin"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="archive_room" to="front_desk"/>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="front_desk" to="reading_hall"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="reading_hall"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="oak_bookcase_heavy" location="reading_hall"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="oak_bookcase_heavy" from="reading_hall" to="return_bin"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="return_bin"/>
                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="oak_bookcase_heavy" location="return_bin"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

Beta (id beta) waited in the reading hall (reading_hall) to receive it. Their route went through the archive room (archive_room), the only overlap between Alpha’s permitted area—charge pod and archive—and Beta’s permitted area—archive and reading hall.

Alpha carried the heavy set into the archive, but the first handover attempt to Beta fumbled, scattering volumes. They were ready to retry, and the backup handover went smoothly. Beta then brought the encyclopedia set into the reading hall, mission complete. The charging pod remained available for recharging.

                </Fallback>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>

Your task:
- Convert the provided natural-language mission description into an XML-formatted multi-agent behavior tree.
- The behavior tree must be compatible with the BehaviorTree.CPP library (<root BTCPP_format="4">), with one <BehaviorTree> per robot coordinated by a main tree.
- Use Fallback nodes to recover from the failures mentioned in the mission.
- Use SignalReady/WaitReady and the Handover/Co* joint nodes for inter-robot coordination.

Output Requirements:
- Output only the XML representation of the behavior tree. Do not include explanations, comments, or any additional text.
- Every robot mentioned in the mission must have its own <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_<name>">.
input: Alpha (alpha) and Beta (beta), this mission is critical. The rare manuscript (rare_manuscript) is currently in the book return bin (return_bin). Your objective is to deliver it to the restoration lab (restoration_lab). Alpha, you start at the archive room (archive_room) and may only operate in the book return bin and the archive room. Beta, you start at the restoration lab and may only operate in the archive room and the restoration lab. Understand the layout: the archive room connects to the front desk (front_desk), the restoration lab, and the book return bin. The charging pod (charge_pod) connects to the reading hall (reading_hall), the restoration lab, and the book return bin. The front desk connects to the archive room and the reading hall. The reading hall connects to the charging pod and the front desk. The restoration lab connects to the archive room and the charging pod. The book return bin connects to the archive room and the charging pod. Use the charging pod as your charging station. Proceed: Alpha, go to the book return bin, retrieve the manuscript, and carry it to the archive room. Beta, meet Alpha there, take the manuscript, and bring it to the restoration lab. Execute.
output:
<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="2" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="archive_room" to="return_bin"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="return_bin"/>
                <IsItemAt item="rare_manuscript" location="return_bin"/>
                <PickUp robot="alpha" item="rare_manuscript" location="return_bin"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="alpha" from="return_bin" to="archive_room"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="archive_room"/>
                <SignalReady robot="alpha" item="rare_manuscript" to="beta"/>
                <HandoverGive giver="alpha" receiver="beta" item="rare_manuscript" location="archive_room"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="restoration_lab" to="archive_room"/>
            <Sequence>
                <WaitReady robot="beta" item="rare_manuscript" from="alpha"/>
                <HandoverTake receiver="beta" giver="alpha" item="rare_manuscript" location="archive_room"/>
            </Sequence>
            <MoveTo robot="beta" from="archive_room" to="restoration_lab"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="beta" item="rare_manuscript"/>
                <PlaceDown robot="beta" item="rare_manuscript" location="restoration_lab"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
</root>

Each robot has a narrow operating area: Alpha can act only at the reading hall and the front desk (front_desk); Beta can operate only at the front desk and the charging pod; Gamma can operate only at the charging pod and the archive room. So the novels must be passed from Alpha to Beta at the front desk, then from Beta to Gamma at the charging pod. But the mission has two known hazards. Beta's battery is weak and dies after one move; it must reach a charging station and recharge before continuing. And the first handover attempt of the novel stack between Beta and Gamma may fumble, so be ready to retry it. The floor plan makes the relay possible: the archive room connects to the charging pod; the charging pod connects to the front desk and the book return bin (return_bin); the front desk connects to the reading hall and the return bin; and the return bin connects to the restoration lab (restoration_lab).

Beta (id beta) starts in the storage shed (storage_shed), while Gamma (id gamma) powers up at the irrigation station (irrigation_station), where the seedling tray (seedling_tray) rests.

Their goals: bring the heavy water tank to the storage shed, carry the seedling tray to the compost area (compost_area), and water the storage shed using the skill WaterPlants. WaterPlants is invoked by a robot standing in a location to water the plants there. The passage between the storage shed and seedling row A may be blocked by debris; a robot at the storage shed can clear it with ClearPath before passing. Gamma’s weak battery dies after 1 moves, so it must reach the charging spot (charge_spot) and Recharge before continuing.

The route network links the charging spot and storage shed to each other and to seedling row A; seedling row A also links to compost area and seedling row B (seedling_row_b), which links to irrigation station and compost area.

Alpha should haul the tank through connected routes; Beta can clear paths; Gamma must recharge quickly, then help move the tray. Once all objects are placed, WaterPlants will make the storage shed flourish.

<?xml version="1.0" ?>
<root BTCPP_format="4" main_tree_to_execute="MainTree">
    <BehaviorTree ID="MainTree">
        <Parallel success_threshold="3" failure_threshold="1">
            <SubTree ID="Agent_alpha"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_beta"/>
            <SubTree ID="Agent_gamma"/>
        </Parallel>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_alpha">
        <Sequence>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="seedling_row_a"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="water_tank_heavy" location="seedling_row_a"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="water_tank_heavy" from="seedling_row_a" to="storage_shed"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="alpha" location="storage_shed"/>
                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="water_tank_heavy" location="storage_shed"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_beta">
        <Sequence>
            <WaterPlants robot="beta" location="storage_shed"/>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="beta" from="storage_shed" to="seedling_row_a"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <ClearPath robot="beta" edge_from="storage_shed" edge_to="seedling_row_a"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="beta" from="storage_shed" to="seedling_row_a"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="seedling_row_a"/>
                <CoPickUp robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="water_tank_heavy" location="seedling_row_a"/>
            </Sequence>
            <CoMoveTo robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="water_tank_heavy" from="seedling_row_a" to="storage_shed"/>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="beta" location="storage_shed"/>
                <CoPlaceDown robot1="alpha" robot2="beta" item="water_tank_heavy" location="storage_shed"/>
            </Sequence>
        </Sequence>
    </BehaviorTree>
    <BehaviorTree ID="Agent_gamma">
        <Sequence>
            <Sequence>
                <IsAtLocation robot="gamma" location="irrigation_station"/>
                <IsItemAt item="seedling_tray" location="irrigation_station"/>
                <PickUp robot="gamma" item="seedling_tray" location="irrigation_station"/>
            </Sequence>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="irrigation_station" to="seedling_row_b"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="irrigation_station" to="seedling_row_b"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_b" to="seedling_row_a"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_a" to="charge_spot"/>
                    <Recharge robot="gamma" station="charge_spot"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="charge_spot" to="seedling_row_a"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_a" to="seedling_row_b"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_b" to="irrigation_station"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="irrigation_station" to="seedling_row_b"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <Fallback>
                <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_b" to="compost_area"/>
                <Sequence>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_b" to="seedling_row_a"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_a" to="charge_spot"/>
                    <Recharge robot="gamma" station="charge_spot"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="charge_spot" to="seedling_row_a"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_a" to="seedling_row_b"/>
                    <MoveTo robot="gamma" from="seedling_row_b" to="compost_area"/>
                </Sequence>
            </Fallback>
            <Sequence>
                <IsCarrying robot="gamma" item="seedling_tray"/>
